edits.text: - As a last resort, prefer a cut after a verb's immediately following essential complement (object, prepositional phrase of place/time/measurement, or clausal complement) over a cut immediately after the finite verb/copula/auxiliary.

- Keep a finite verb, copula, or auxiliary together with an immediately following essential complement (a clausal/direct-object phrase; a prepositional phrase of place, time, or measurement; a numeral+unit; or a named location).
